title: Xmas Fayre — Lenches Preschool
body: Stroll, eat cake and celebrate at the preschool's Christmas fayre, with festive craft stalls, a tombola and seasonal cheer, 3.30pm to 5.30pm. Stalls are available: contact Sinead (secretary@thelenchespreschool.org.uk) to book a table.

image.alt: Poster for the Lenches Preschool Xmas Fayre: Friday 11 December, 3.30pm till 5.30pm, festive craft stalls, tombola and seasonal cheer, stalls available, with hanging Christmas decorations, Santa and a snowman
